text:
tara_cs: FYI HeliosCare (acct 9344) invoice #8451 autopay failed twice. Customer asks if they can do ACH micro-deposits instead of retrying the card.

eli_fin: Share decline codes + last4. Also, ACH micro-deposit setup can take 1-2 business days; wire is faster if they need immediate access.

tara_cs: last4 7623. Declines: `insufficient_funds`, then `do_not_honor`. Attempts 2026-03-25T10:05Z and 10:28Z. PO on file: PO-8803. Customer message: "Treasury prefers ACH micro-deposits; they'll authorize once verified. Can you pause card retries and send ACH instructions?"

billing-bot: [automated] Payment log: invoice=8451 attempts=2 status=failed gateway=stripe region=us-east-2

noah_billing: We can support ACH micro-deposit. Process: 1) disable card auto-retries; 2) create manual invoice with payment_method=ach_pending; 3) send micro-deposit instructions and expected timeline; 4) reconcile once micro-deposits verified and clear. For urgent access, offer wire as expedited path. Waive one late fee for onboarding case.

maya_sales: Customer is pilot tier, needs access ASAP but prefers ACH. Offer both: accept ACH (note 48-72h) and provide wire as express option. Also include one-time pay link as fallback.

eli_fin: Approved. Action items: tara_cs to get written confirmation that treasury will complete micro-deposit verification and include reference "Invoice 8451 / PO-8803" (eta 2h). noah_billing to create manual invoice flagged payment_method=ach_pending, disable auto card retries, and attach ACH instructions. If customer later requests wire, create wire instructions and flag invoice accordingly. Attach proof of deposit/confirmation to ticket before marking paid.

tara_cs: Sending ACH template via secure channel now and asking for confirmation. Customer replied: "We'll start micro-deposits today and notify once verified. If verification fails, we'll wire immediately."

billing-bot: Ticket BILL-4899 created for invoice 8451 (ach_pending).

noah_billing: Noted. I'll create the manual invoice and set accounting hold until verification. If no verification within 72h, escalate to finance lead.

tara_cs: I'll update thread when treasury confirms micro-deposit amounts or requests wire. Thanks.
